import pandas as pd

def ensure_index(index_like, copy=False):
    if isinstance(index_like, list):
        if all(isinstance(x, tuple) for x in index_like):
            return pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(index_like)
        elif all(isinstance(x, list) for x in index_like):
            return pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays(index_like)
    else:
        return pd.Index(index_like, dtype='object')
